info.title: Wefty L1 agent protocol
info.description: Fabric-authenticated node registration, liveness, claim, lease, log, and completion protocol.

post.summary: Register a stable node and per-boot session
post.description: The request cannot self-report tags. The response includes authoritative tags derived from Fabric identity and operator configuration.

200.description: Node boot session registered.

post.summary: Update liveness and capabilities, then receive node-scoped directives
post.description: Boot-session-scoped and never attempt-authority-generation-fenced. Capability replacement, liveness, and effective capacity commit atomically without changing durable claim intent. The response carries claim intent, effective class capacities, and pending removal directives even when the node owns no attempt.

200.description: Node liveness updated and the current node-scoped intent channel returned.

get.summary: Long-poll a fresh node/boot-bound Computer policy snapshot
get.description: Returns immediately for a newer revision or policy topology change and otherwise renews the short freshness lease before expiry. The node must discard policy on watch loss, expiry, regression, or generation change.

200.description: Fresh in-memory policy snapshot.

204.description: This node has never hosted a Computer; ordinary service behavior is unchanged.

post.summary: Acknowledge an issued snapshot after installation and session closure
post.description: The receipt is derived from the installed in-memory snapshot. A dedicated retry loop sends it only after every authorization downgraded by this revision has released after closing both relay legs, without parking heartbeat or watch. A replacement boot does not complete revocation until any older boot policy lease expires or that boot already acknowledged the revision.

post.summary: Drain this agent boot session for graceful shutdown
post.description: Changes boot-session liveness to draining without mutating durable operator claim intent or fencing existing attempts. Fenced attempt completions continue through the ordinary completion route.

200.description: Node is draining; existing attempt authority remains valid.

post.summary: Atomically claim one eligible queued job in one workload class
post.description: Eligibility, class capacity, service binding, and agent-local job exclusions are evaluated inside the claim transaction using authenticated authoritative node policy. Exclusions prevent this boot session from re-claiming a job whose prior attempt is still being finalized locally. The request intentionally contains no tags or capacity.

excluded_job_ids.description: Jobs still resident in this agent boot through process, log, completion, renewal, or handoff finalization.

200.description: Claim won; attempt, fence, and lease were created atomically.

prestart_deadline.description: One-shot OCI only. Absolute persisted deadline shared by every pre-Started attempt and used to clamp agent-owned image delivery policy.

computer_storage.description: Computer claims only. Exact durable Storage identity, current disk budget, submission policy, and optional one-shot chown authority authorized by the current immutable Job projection.

post.summary: Renew one attempt lease
post.description: Distinct from node heartbeat. A success returns a duration TTL and any attempt-scoped service directive; stale fence, attempt mismatch, or expiry returns 409 without granting write authority.

200.description: Lease renewed with a duration TTL and any stop or restart directive for this payload.

put.summary: Set absolute publication state for one service attempt
put.description: L1 derives an ordinary service's immutable port from its specification; a Computer instead supplies its private Fabric front-door display endpoint only while ready. The mutation is authorized in fenced-write order, is not replayable after terminalization, and leaves the database untouched when the stored publication already equals the requested state.

200.description: Publication changed or was already in the requested state.

put.summary: Record one fenced, write-once OCI image observation

200.description: Observation accepted or identically replayed.

post.summary: Acknowledge authoritative OCI Started idempotently
post.description: This is the sole claimed-to-running transition for OCI attempts.

200.description: Started accepted or identically replayed.

post.summary: Append an idempotent batch of per-stream log events
post.description: L1 is the sole owner of idempotency for (attempt_id, stream, sequence). Identical replay is acknowledged without duplication; conflicting replay or an undeclared sequence gap is rejected. Raw byte chunks are not scanned or decoded as lines. Lost attempts accept in-sequence evidence by original job/node/attempt/fence provenance during the late-evidence window without changing verdict or authority; after that window raw events become truthful per-stream gap records.

200.description: Batch accepted or identically replayed. Ack sequences are per stream and are upload acknowledgements, not reader cursors.

post.summary: Complete one attempt idempotently

200.description: Completion accepted or identically replayed.

post.summary: Attest that bound service cleanup completed
post.description: Acknowledgement strictly follows local deletion. L1 validates Fabric identity, current boot session, bound node, generation, opaque cleanup fence, root-instance ID, idempotency key, and body hash in one transaction, then finalizes the tombstone in a separate crash-recoverable transaction.

200.description: Deletion attestation accepted, identically replayed, or already finalized without mutation.

post.summary: Append one immutable, attempt-fenced Computer take-over event
post.description: Identical event replay is idempotent. L1 derives authority generation from the attempt and never stores the request fencing token. Session-open must commit before forwarding and session-close before the agent discards the session.

200.description: Event committed or identically replayed.

post.summary: Publish a verified cold Backup or an assertion-derived absent failure
post.description: The current authenticated node returns a helper receipt bound to the planned copy, source Storage generation, Node, root instance, Job, operation revision, and cleanup fence. Success requires full allocation, matching digest, and encryption=none; ENOSPC or digest mismatch requires positive copy absence.

200.description: Exact receipt accepted or replayed; logical Backup publication and unchanged-intent resume are atomic. backup is omitted for a positively absent ENOSPC or digest-mismatch failure.

post.summary: Attest positive absence of one managed Backup copy

200.description: Copy absence accepted; the logical Backup is retained as a pruned record.

204.description: A create superseded by Computer removal had no logical Backup; its planned physical copy is positively absent.

post.summary: Publish an assertion-derived restore, clone, or Custody import destination
post.description: The receipt binds source bytes and destination Storage authority. Custody import additionally binds the immutable export event, external path, and manifest digest, and requires clone-style OS identity rekeying.

old_backup_receipt.description: Exact Computer Backup copy receipt for the precommitted old generation; forbidden when keep_old_as_backup was false.

200.description: Destination published or identically replayed; clones are stable and stopped, while restores remain stopped pending predecessor retirement.

post.summary: Record assertion-derived completion of an already-tainting Custody export

200.description: Completion evidence recorded; the pre-write custody taint remains permanent.

post.summary: Complete restore after shared predecessor absence proof

200.description: Predecessor absence accepted; the restored Computer is stable and remains stopped.

post.summary: Accept an assertion-derived Computer disk grow result
post.description: The authenticated current node submits a helper receipt bound to Computer, Storage generation, exact managed-root instance, Job, operation revision and fence, and old/new byte counts. Applied receipts advance desired_disk_bytes; insufficient_disk receipts prove an unchanged disk and latch explicit-restart recovery.

200.description: Grow result accepted or identically replayed.

post.summary: Accept assertion-derived Computer reimage preflight evidence
post.description: The authenticated current node submits helper evidence binding the exact managed-root instance, old and staging Jobs, operation revision and fence, target digest and platform, image and disk-root ownership, and either positive detachment or verified reset-preparation evidence. L1 atomically records successful evidence and activates the staged projection in the acknowledgement transaction; no client replay is required to leave reimaging. Every bounded preflight refusal carries a closed stage and reason so L1 can release the refused staging projection with typed status instead of redispatching indefinitely.

200.description: Preflight evidence accepted or identically replayed.

post.summary: Publish one verified replacement Storage generation
post.description: The authenticated current node submits a helper-derived preparation receipt bound to Computer, Storage, old/new generations, exact managed-root instance, Job, reset intent revision, cleanup fence, and helper generation. L1 commits verification before separately publishing generation+1; the old generation remains for shared removal afterward.

200.description: Successor preparation accepted or identically replayed; the returned stopped Computer has the successor published and predecessor retirement still pending.

post.summary: Complete reset after shared predecessor removal
post.description: After authority-bound Computer disk deletion and assertion-derived shared removal attestation, the authenticated current node submits the same cleanup authority shape used by service removal. L1 then completes the reset while leaving the Computer stopped.

200.description: Predecessor absence accepted or replayed; the returned Computer is stable and stopped.
